admission: Operator-approved move of the aarch64 VMware build worker from FreeBSD 15.1-RELEASE to 16.0-CURRENT in a new boot environment that keeps 15.1 for rollback. Tarball sets into a cloned BE: no pkgbase conversion, no source build, no reboot by the agent.
scope: Host preparation only. be16 is activated but has not booted. No aarch64 world, kernel, jail, package, image or VM result exists, and nothing here admits the worker to the release graph or qualifies aarch64.

worker.identity: operator VMware guest on Apple silicon; address and hostname kept out of this record
worker.virtual_platform: VMware20,1 arm64 guest, UEFI firmware, NVMe disk, e1000e NIC (em0)
worker.resize_note: At preflight the guest already reported 8 vCPUs and about 16 GiB, booted two minutes earlier: the operator's resize had already happened.

preflight.disk_layout: GPT nda0 200G: p1 efi 260M (gpt/efiboot0), p2 freebsd-swap 2G, p3 freebsd-zfs 198G
preflight.base_management_finding: The base was pkgbase, not distribution sets as assumed: 316 FreeBSD-* 15.1 packages from the FreeBSD-base repository, enabled in /usr/local/etc/pkg/repos/FreeBSD.conf, plus 116 ports packages (432 in total).

boot_environments.new: be16 (bectl create be16: a clone of default)
boot_environments.activated: be16; zroot bootfs is zroot/ROOT/be16; bectl list shows be16 R, default N

be16_changes.kernel: boot/kernel moved to boot/kernel.15 (15.1 kernel sha256 afdbd30ec9e65d904f12f995de2d6f32d7e47e0f4aa1a45f379772a9dafc1468); kernel.txz extracted (boot/kernel/kernel sha256 8152218c4f1a5d7ddab7ac0c7619eb4827e956fa7d3ce14726d020a9e921970d). usr/lib/debug/boot/kernel (15.1 debug files) moved to kernel.15.
be16_changes.base: base.txz extracted with tar -xpf --clear-nochange-fflags, excluding ./etc, ./root/*, ./boot/device.hints and the contents of the shared dataset mountpoints (var/audit, var/crash, var/log, var/mail, var/tmp, tmp, usr/src, usr/ports). The only tar error was restoring the time on schg var/empty. Spot checks of schg files (libc.so.7, ld-elf.so.1, init, su, login, sh, sshd, loader.efi) match the archive.
be16_changes.lib32: lib32.txz extracted the same way, because the 15.1 pkgbase install had lib32; usr/lib32/libc.so.7 matches the archive.

etcupdate.method: The worker had no /var/db/etcupdate, and etcupdate -t expects a build tarball, not base.txz. Both trees were made from the release sets: etc, root and boot/device.hints from the 15.1-RELEASE and 16 base.txz. Then etcupdate extract -D /mnt/be16 -t etcupdate-15.1.txz, a dry run (-n), and etcupdate -F -D /mnt/be16 -t etcupdate-16.txz.

local-only: etc/rc.conf, etc/fstab, etc/resolv.conf, etc/hostid, etc/machine-id, etc/zfs/exports, etc/ssh host keys
etcupdate.result: exit 0; conflicts: none; etcupdate status reports nothing outstanding

etcupdate.updated: 54 unmodified stock files (rc.subr, rc.d, defaults/rc.conf, sshd_config, ssh_config, login.conf, pkg/FreeBSD.conf and others)

pkg.repository_config: usr/local/etc/pkg/repos/FreeBSD.conf in be16 now disables FreeBSD-base; the 15.1 file is kept as FreeBSD.conf.15-pkgbase. pkg -r reads repository files from the host, so a pkg.conf naming be16's REPOS_DIR was passed with -C.
pkg.ignore_osversion: IGNORE_OSVERSION=yes: the repository packages are built for 1600029 and the snapshot userland is 1600028.
pkg.upgraded: All 116 ports packages were reinstalled or upgraded to FreeBSD:16. python312 and cups were force-reinstalled, because their 15 builds were newer than the 16 catalogue's. 125 ports packages, all FreeBSD:16.
pkg.base_records: 316 FreeBSD-* 15.1 package records remain in be16's pkg database while their files now come from the 16 sets. That is cosmetic for booting; the operator chooses later between removing the records and moving base to pkgbase 16.

esp_changes.source: be16 boot/loader.efi from the 16 base.txz (FreeBSD/arm64 EFI loader, Revision 3.1)
esp_changes.note: The two loaders were copied and renamed into place. The 15.1 copies stay beside them and in a scratch backup on the worker. The default BE's /boot/loader.efi is still the 15.1 file.

source_checkout.head: 4bfe2344af74e31ef7e305fc6fb3caa579468330

pending_reboot: Boot be16 and record uname -a and freebsd-version -kru.

The selected source is 1600029 and the snapshot kernel 1600028, while a poudriere jail cannot be newer than its host kernel. Build the native aarch64 GENERIC kernel at the selected source (kernel-toolchain, buildkernel), install it and reboot again first. That is also the first aarch64 kernel build.
Create the 16aarch64 poudriere jail from /usr/src at the selected revision (-m src=/usr/src -K GENERIC), then follow HACKING.md's @clean, lib32 and /usr/src checks.
Run native/inspect-worker-allocation.py for admission. The disk is 200G; docs/aarch64.md sizes the worker at 400 GiB.
rollback: At the loader menu, choose Boot Environments and select default (a one-time boot).
Or run bectl activate default and reboot.
If the 16 loader ever fails to start, restore efi/freebsd/loader-15.1.efi and efi/boot/bootaa64-15.1.efi over the active names from the EFI shell or rescue media.
